title: 雨林静狮

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮粗看：人物左侧跪坐、单狮右侧闭眼安卧，双手与鬃毛接触自然，苔石地台完整；只记录明显关系，未做统一复核。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque full-frame tarot card master for later holographic card production
Primary request: Create ONE original opaque full-frame 1024x1536 vertical Strength tarot master, theme 雨林静狮 / Rainforest Quiet Lion.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity, symbolic relationship, and painterly tarot-style reference only; create a new composition.
Subject: exactly ONE graceful dark-haired woman kneeling on the LEFT, wearing an elegant deep teal and plum gown; exactly ONE full-sized golden male lion lying peacefully on the RIGHT. The lion's eyes are fully closed, mouth closed, body relaxed. The woman uses BOTH visible hands to gently rest on and stroke the lion's mane; palms meet the mane naturally and do not intersect the head.
Scene/backdrop: sheltered emerald rainforest with layered mist and tall foliage. Large leaves frame ONLY the two upper corners and do not cover faces or hands.
Composition/framing: woman left kneeling, lion right reclining in side/front three-quarter view. Their complete connected grouping rests on a broad moss-covered stone platform; the entire area beneath the lion's belly, forelegs, woman, and fabric is solid and continuous to the bottom bleed. Thin leaf-vein and mane-gold tarot border.
Style/medium: richly detailed hand-painted fantasy tarot illustration, luminous natural textures, opaque RGB full scene.
Lighting/mood: calm courage, trust, protection, soft rainforest light.
Color palette: emerald green, lion gold, deep teal, natural skin.
Constraints: exactly one woman and one lion; lion must be visibly resting with eyes closed and mouth closed; both hands touch the mane gently; full paws and supporting ground visible; no dominance pose.
Avoid: extra people, lion cubs, duplicate lion, roaring, open mouth, attack, pounce, circus, animal-taming performance, hand passing through skull, severed head, floating figures, thin pedestal, text, title, letters, numbers, watermark, logo.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass coarse visual check; no transparent layers, assembly, or formal review.
